topics.title: Darren's Obsessive Letter
topics.summary: A radio host, Howard, interviews a mysterious guest named Darren who repeatedly expresses an unsettling obsession with Robin through increasingly detailed letters detailing fantasies involving foot licking. The conversation becomes awkward as Darren’s bizarre declarations and requests are read aloud on air.

topics.title: Robin and Darren’s Birthday Conflict
topics.summary: During Robin’s birthday broadcast, her friend Darren repeatedly offers unsolicited advice about her relationship despite her clear disinterest. His persistent comments and attempts to influence the situation escalate tension, leading to a frustrated exchange where he ultimately leaves the program.”}id: 1678923456

topics.title: Arthur Gold & Midtown Mayhem
topics.summary: A chaotic radio show features a bizarre interview with Arthur Gold and his wife discussing their unusual lifestyle including spending money on TVs for Leona Helmsley. The hosts debate Guns N' Roses versus the Rolling Stones while exploring an AIDS vaccine tested on two gay monkeys, leading to awkward questions about human sexuality.

topics.title: Radio Show Chaos & City Disarray
topics.summary: In 1989, college radio host recounts his fired broadcast featuring Godzilla in Harlem and bizarre phone calls. Amidst reports of eleven murders across New York City and a mayoral campaign involving Dinkins endorsements, the program includes chaotic conversations with callers including one about bloody Wednesday and another promoting David Dinkins for mayor.

topics.title: Candidate Support and Strange Events
topics.summary: During a call-in show, callers discuss supporting a candidate after an aggressive debate. They then delve into bizarre topics including the trial of a young Russian killer who gambled to conviction, a pace university fraternity prank involving ‘sheep run north,’ and a former contestant’s success managing rock bands – alongside discussions about obscene radio bills and a confusing series of events.

topics.title: Hot Tub Testicle Loss Incident
topics.summary: A man suffered a testicle loss after it was sucked into a malfunctioning hot tub drain in Italy. The incident, described as ‘horrifying,’ prompted an investigation and a $1 million lawsuit against the hotel; callers discussed potential causes of the accident and expressed anxieties regarding similar events.
